body.message:
As mentioned in our previous message, we can extend your stay for an additional 2 nights, from 27th September to 29th September.

The total rate for the 2-night extension will be AED 1,325.89.

Unfortunately, we are unable to reduce the rate any further, as this is the best rate available for the requested dates.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.
